long_biography.plain_text:
Merlin moved from France to Southeast Asia and helped launch Exotissimo in Vietnam in 1993, when tourism infrastructure was limited and foreign operators faced a new market. The venture began with a small team and became a regional destination-management network, pairing local partnerships with tailored travel across successive Asian markets.

He broadened that foundation through AppleTree, developing hotels, heritage cruises, import businesses and consumer brands. With his wife, Ha, he also built Annam Gourmet from a small imported-food shop into a Vietnamese premium-supermarket group. More recently, Merlin co-founded FEBE Ventures to back early-stage entrepreneurs, carrying operational lessons from travel, hospitality and retail into investment. Across these ventures, his recurring approach has been to build niche businesses around service quality, regional knowledge and long-term partnerships.
